correctness.rationale: Positive weights make variance strictly convex modulo constants; every extremizer has a connected tight-edge graph, hence integer values in range 0..3. Range-three profile is forced by one omitted matched pair; all range-two potentials with deleted-pair gap two have disconnected tight edges. Remaining extremizers are one-side signs. Direct weighted moments yield E_i and α−δ_A²,β−δ_B². The sixteen-large-weight reduction from PARTITION proves restricted rational-input NP-completeness. Exact-rational full integral-potential enumeration for n=3,4,5 and twelve symmetric/asymmetric profiles reproduced branch maxima and complete winning shapes; this is corroboration, not a replacement for proof.
